notes: Final fixture benchmarks ran sequentially after tests. Fresh reader means cold application cache; OS caches were not purged.
Fixture contains 676 distinct airport pairs, shuffled observed departure times, cancelled and blocked facts; graph cardinality is much smaller than the live archive.
Live reads used mode=ro, query_only and a two-second SQLite work deadline after the deployment check exited. No live app end-to-end benchmark or full count/catalog timing was completed.
